narrative.intro: Mission Support and Test Services received $997M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, with 5 awards and an average award size of $199M. Mission Support and Test Services obligations are up 0.2% year over year. Mission Support and Test Services saw $996M obligated by the Department of Energy and $77.7K obligated by the General Services Administration. Mission Support and Test Services sells primarily Facilities Support Services, which accounted for $996M in obligations, and General Automotive Repair, which accounted for $77.7K. Mission Support and Test Services obligations have moved from $855M in FY21 to $923M in FY22, $838M in FY23, $1.1B in FY24, $995M in FY25, and $997M in FY26 to date. Mission Support and Test Services current-year totals are partial because the period reported is fiscal year to date, and the note clarifies that figures are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables. Mission Support and Test Services average award size is the simple ratio shown as $199M given the 5 awards and total obligations reported.
